channel.title: PowerCue Beta updates
channel.description: Beta builds of PowerCue (PowerCue Beta only; the released PowerCue reads appcast.xml).

item.title: Beta 1.0.33 (68)
item.description:
• Timed holds in Play. Write [Pause 5s] in the script as a screen direction (Hold and Wait work too) and Play stops there for that long, with a countdown beside it, then rolls on. The hourglass button in the editor bar puts one in; type another time over the 5.
  • Each hold runs once per take. Back to Top runs them all again. Pause, the arrows or scrolling by hand end a hold early.
  • A linked iPhone or iPad stops with the Mac during a hold and rolls on with it.
  • The script's name in the top bar. Click it to rename the script. The arrow beside it opens Previous Projects, New Project, Open Project and Save Project As.
  • A 14-day trial. If you tried a PowerCue Beta before 1.0.33, you get 14 days again, counted from the first time you open 1.0.33 or later. Later updates do not start it again.
  • Everything in PowerCue 1.0.32, and recording with PowerCue Pro or the trial.

item.title: Beta 1.0.33 (67)
item.description:
• A 14-day trial. If you tried PowerCue Beta before, you get 14 days again, counted from the first time you open this version. Later updates do not start it again.
  • The installer window has a new background: the arrow sits between the icons and is sharp on Retina.
  • Everything in PowerCue 1.0.32, and recording with PowerCue Pro or the trial.

item.title: Beta 1.0.32 (65)
item.description:
• Allow Screen Recording, right where it is needed. When screen recording is not allowed yet, the button sits under the message in New Recording and in the Recording section, in the preview at any window size, and under a Record that could not start. It opens System Settings at Privacy & Security, Screen Recording; switch PowerCue Beta on there, then quit and reopen it.
  • Screen and Camera switches in New Recording: turn either off for a take of the other alone. One of the two is always on.
  • New Recording opens in Side by side every time.
  • Record without a camera, or without a screen. Without a camera your voice goes into the screen file (macOS 15 and later).
  • PowerCue in the menu bar. Start a recording of a display, a selection, a window or an app, the screen or the camera alone, or open a small quick bar. While you record, a stop button with the time and a pause button sit in the menu bar.
  • A red line around the screen while a display is recorded. It is not in the recording.
  • When the camera is not connected, PowerCue asks whether to record the screen only instead of not starting.
  • Editing in the prompter: Undo and Redo work, and pasted text takes the style of the words before it.
  • Voice Follow: Smooth scrolling no longer moves the text on background noise, and a phrase heard from much earlier no longer sends the prompter back several paragraphs.
  • Check for Updates in the menu bar menu, and a dot on the icon when an update is waiting.
  • Everything in PowerCue 1.0.31, and recording with PowerCue Pro or the trial.

item.title: Beta 1.0.31 (55)
item.description:
• Voice Follow in Bulgarian, and in Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese and Slovenian, which Apple's speech recognition does not have. PowerCue downloads a speech model for them once (about 460 MB); following runs on your Mac.
  • A marker added over selected text now goes in front of it. The text stays.
  • Everything in PowerCue 1.0.30, and recording with PowerCue Pro or the trial.
